title: Vivaldi browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each Vivaldi profile holds its own history, sessions, mail accounts and saved logins. The profiles show who used the browser and what they were doing.
source: Chromium user data directory docs (Vivaldi uses User Data with per-profile folders): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences marker file so non-profile folders are skipped. Vivaldi Snapshots use a separate Vivaldi Snapshot/User Data tree.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Vivaldi, use Vivaldi menu > File > Export > Export Passwords, and export bookmarks if you want to keep them.
cleanup.signOut: In Vivaldi, open Settings > Sync and log out, so the browser stops syncing with your Vivaldi account.
steps: Uninstall Vivaldi from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Vivaldi user data folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Vivaldi profile on this PC: history, saved logins, mail accounts, cookies and sessions.
cleanup.source: Vivaldi Browser Help, Import and export browser data: https://help.vivaldi.com/desktop/tools/import-and-export-browser-data
